summary: Completed comprehensive Phase 6 testing (Maintenance + GPS complete). Backend: 159/163 tests passed (97.5%). Frontend: All major features working correctly. Maintenance module fully functional with CRUD, reminders, and booking blocks (INV-21). GPS complete with live tracking, geofence auto-status, history, and share-links. Public tracking page accessible without auth.

details: GET /api/maintenance returns array with 3 seeded records
POST /api/maintenance creates record (owner/ops_admin only, driver denied 403)
GET /api/maintenance/reminders returns KIR/Pajak/Servis buckets with H-30/14/7 urgency
GET /api/maintenance/summary returns counts (total, scheduled, in_progress, done, cancelled, due_soon, overdue)
PATCH /api/maintenance/{id} updates record
POST /api/maintenance/{id}/complete sets status to 'done' and returns vehicle to available
DELETE /api/maintenance/{id} removes record
Filters work: vehicle_id, status, type
Vehicle V-03 (Isuzu Elf) has in_progress maintenance window (now-1d to now+2d)
GET /api/bookings/availability returns available=false with non-empty maintenance array
POST /api/bookings during maintenance window rejected with 400 'Armada dalam masa perawatan'
GET /api/locations/live returns array with last_seen, age_seconds, stale (bool), live_status (moving|idle|offline)
Stale indicator works: age > 180 seconds marked as stale=true, live_status=offline
Live status correctly shows: moving (speed > 3 km/h), idle (speed <= 3 km/h), offline (stale)
POST /api/locations with trip_id near destination (within ~300m) triggers geofence
Trip status auto-updated from 'on_trip' to 'completed'
Response includes geofence object: {event: 'arrived_destination', new_status: 'completed'}
Vehicle status updated to 'available' when trip completed
GET /api/locations/history with no params returns empty array (not 500)
GET /api/locations/history?vehicle_id={id} returns ordered location points (6 points found)
GET /api/locations/history?trip_id={id} returns trip-specific points (6 points found)
Points ordered by timestamp ascending
POST /api/shares creates share-link with token, expires_at, is_active flag
GET /api/shares returns array with is_active and expired flags
GET /api/shares?active=true filters active shares
POST /api/shares/{id}/revoke sets revoked=true, is_active=false
DELETE /api/shares/{id} removes share
RBAC: driver denied 403, owner/ops_admin allowed
GET /api/public/track/{token} works WITHOUT Authorization header
Returns: vehicle_name, status, current{lat,lng}, eta{eta_minutes,distance_km}, track[], stale, expires_at
Revoked token returns 403
Invalid token returns 404
Frontend: Public tracking page loads without login, shows error for invalid token
KPI cards render (4 cards: Total Catatan, Terjadwal, Sedang Berlangsung, Dokumen Due/Overdue)
Document reminder banner shows 3 pills: V-03 KIR-7 hari, V-02 Pajak-9 hari, V-01 Servis-14 hari
Table lists 4 maintenance records with status pills (Terjadwal, Berlangsung, Selesai)
'Jadwalkan Perawatan' button opens dialog
Complete (check), edit, delete actions present
Three mode tabs present: Live, Riwayat, Bagikan
Live tab: Leaflet map renders with vehicle marker, route polyline, ETA info
Riwayat tab: Can select vehicle to load track history
Bagikan tab: Share link creation form (Trip dropdown, Label input, Berlaku dropdown)
Bagikan tab: List shows 3 existing shares with 'Aktif' status
Salin, Revoke, Delete buttons present for each share
All existing endpoints still work: /api/dashboard, /api/vehicles, /api/bookings, /api/trips, /api/payments, /api/leads, /api/reports/summary
Anti-double-booking (INV-4) still rejects overlapping bookings with 400
Frontend pages load without errors: dashboard, vehicles, bookings, trips, customers, leads
